title: Prescribed exceptional transports with their actual cross-field action
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l in an independent universe, a finite-field datum D of characteristic p different from l, finite-type k-schemes X,Y and a separated finite-type k-map f. For a compactification c, Transport records the given exact adjunctions at finite, integral, rational and closed coefficient stages, their shift-compatible ambient left realizations, and their normalized integral, localization and common-field comparisons. It also records the integral compact-support scalar isomorphisms between common finite fields normalized by the actual whole-system map sfCompactSupportScalarSystemMap, their raw rational localizations, and the closed left functor action on every common-stage transition: after the rational realization and common q comparisons, that action is the common-stage image of the same normalized scalar map. Thus no arbitrary action on cross-field arrows is allowed.

proof.text: Retain the given operations and their published realizations. Package the canonical integral scalar comparison, its raw rational localization, and the closed action on common-stage transition generators as equations. The inherited ring inclusion shift is the canonical shift on the corresponding full subcategory. No object is chosen from an unproved existence statement.
